x-e-m1-01.title: Ṣé Ben yóò wá sí ayẹyẹ náà? Yíyẹ̀wò ìtumọ̀ tó farasin ti àwọn ìdáhùn rẹ̀
x-e-m1-01.goal: Pín àwọn ìdáhùn Ben nínú ìjíròrò náà ní ìlà-ìlà, ya ohun tí a ti yanjú sọ́tọ̀ kúrò lára ohun tó kù, kí o sì ṣe ìdájọ́ láì sọ pé 'yóò wá' tàbí 'kò ní wá'.

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
